name: Node Title Prefix/Suffix
description: Adds a configurable static prefix and/or suffix to node titles on display.
project_description:
Note: Before considering to use this module, you may want to give the successor: Metatag: Page Heading Module a try! 

 This module adds settings for adding prefix and suffix to the page title of entities.

Currently supported entity types:

 
 Nodes 
 Taxonomy Terms (by submodule: "Taxonomy Term Name Prefix") 
 
 Please help us to extend this to support all kinds of entities in this issue: [#3273721]

 Back to top 

 Use 
 After installing the module, go to the entity type edit page and set values for prefix and / or suffix. They are afterwards added to the page title of all entities of this type.

 Back to top 

 Similar modules / Alternatives: 
 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/metatag_page_heading - Superior functionality using the Metatags module as base, which allows altering all entity types and even make per-entity overrides! The only downside might be [#3466638] in rare cases 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/alter_route_title - Alter the route title 
 Automatic Entity Label - modifies the label itself, which is a different approach for other use cases 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/custom_page_title - Overwrite the node title on certain paths 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/exclude_node_title - Remove the page title on certain paths 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/node_display_title - Provide a separate admin title and user-facing title 
 Back to top
